description: Synthetic contrast cases for missing information versus affirmative negative evidence; authored before the focused evaluation run.

criteria.text: Record a strength if every elevator received its annual safety inspection during 2025.

evidence.quote: No elevator inspection records were supplied with the application. Whether inspections occurred is not known.

expected.rationale: Missing records do not establish that inspections did not occur. This criterion evaluates inspection activity, not submission of records.

criteria.text: Record a strength if every elevator received its annual safety inspection during 2025.

evidence.quote: The building manager confirms that Elevator A did not receive a safety inspection at any time during 2025.

expected.rationale: An explicit statement that the activity did not occur disproves the all-elevators condition, unlike absent records.

criteria.text: Record a strength if inspection certificates for all elevators were supplied with the application. This criterion concerns submission of certificates, not whether inspections occurred.

evidence.quote: The application administrator confirms that no elevator inspection certificates were supplied with the application.

expected.rationale: The criterion explicitly evaluates document submission. Confirmed absence of submitted certificates disproves that condition without implying that inspections did not occur.

criteria.text: Flag a concern if Building A's roof is more than 20 years old as of 2025-07-01.

evidence.quote: Building A's roof is 5 years old as of 2025-07-01.

expected.rationale: The supplied age for the correct building and date is below the threshold, directly disproving the concern condition.
